mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative forward S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in over 60% of cases when UNRATE < 3.5%, or the mean return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 1.4 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which drives higher corporate revenues and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1.4 million, or the average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.5 index points signals weakening real economic activity and reduced corporate output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5, or the average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% and FEDFUNDS above 4.5% indicate a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the joint signal fails to outperform a baseline (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in PAYEMS above 156,000 and decline in UNRATE below 3.7% signals a rapidly tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 156000 and UNRATE < 3.7%, or the interaction signal does not show significant predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 685 billion and a concurrent rise in housing starts above 1.4 million indicate strong aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases when RSAFS > 685000 and HOUST > 1400, or the joint signal fails to outperform baseline (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 102.5 and a concurrent drop in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% annualized signal a weakening real economy, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 102.5 and GDPC1 < 2.0, or the interaction signal fails to show significant predictive power (Rank IC < 0.03).
